messages:
jane_acme: Hey team — our production integration started failing with 400s when we pass a JSONL/NDJSON file as the tool args. Blocking a rollout.

jane_acme: Repro (minimal):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary @payload.jsonl
```
payload.jsonl (created on Windows):
```
{"query":"summarize","doc":"First line"}
{"query":"summarize","doc":"Second line"}
```
Response: 400 with body: `{"error":"tool_args: invalid json","code":"invalid_tool_args"}`

olivia_support: Thanks — can you paste the full response body and any server request_id you got? Is the file arriving as raw body for the tool_args field or are you embedding the NDJSON as a string?

jane_acme: Response included `request_id=req_0a1b2c3d`. Server log shows: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)`. We are sending the NDJSON file as the `tool_args` top-level body (i.e., the entire request body is the NDJSON). We thought the endpoint accepted JSONL when Content-Type is application/jsonl.

olivia_support: Redwood toolcall schema expects a JSON object where `tool_args` is a JSON value (object/array/string). The endpoint does not accept raw NDJSON as the top-level request body. That mismatch produces the cryptic 400. Two immediate options:
- wrap your NDJSON content into a JSON array: `[{...},{...}]` and send as `Content-Type: application/json`
- or send the NDJSON as a single string value in `tool_args`, e.g. `{ "tool": "doc_tool", "tool_args": { "ndjson": "{...}\n{...}" } }`

olivia_support: Example corrected payload (inline array):
```json
{
  "tool": "doc_tool",
  "tool_args": {
    "documents": [
      {"query":"summarize","doc":"First line"},
      {"query":"summarize","doc":"Second line"}
    ]
  }
}
```

alex_eng: assigning to eng to improve error text and docs. We should return 422 with "expected JSON object for toolcall, received NDJSON/text" when content-type is application/jsonl or when body can't be parsed as JSON. Can you attach the exact `payload.jsonl` file? Also which client/OS generated it (PowerShell, Node, python)?

jane_acme: attaching sample (copied into thread). It was produced by a Windows pipeline (PowerShell) — CRLF endings and no BOM.

alex_eng: thanks. Repro steps look straightforward. Likely cause: our server tries JSON.parse on the whole body; NDJSON != valid JSON so it raises a generic parse error that client surfaces as 400. I'll open SUP-5791 to: (1) map content-type `application/jsonl` to clearer 422, (2) add doc note for NDJSON (we don't accept top-level NDJSON for tool_args), (3) provide helper in SDK to convert NDJSON -> JSON array.

deploy-bot: Created issue SUP-5791: improve parse error and docs for NDJSON/toolcall handling.

olivia_support: For immediate unblock, jane_acme, can you try sending as an array (example above) and confirm? If it works we'll mark this thread as resolved and track SUP-5791 for UX improvements.

jane_acme: Switched to array payload — that fixed it. No more 400s. Thanks! :thumbsup:

olivia_support: Great. We'll follow up once SUP-5791 lands (docs + clearer error). Closing loop: recommend adding a short note to onboarding doc about not using raw NDJSON as top-level toolcall body.

alex_eng: noted — will include a snippet in the SDK changelog with a helper `ndjson_to_array` and a server-side guard that returns 422 with a friendly message.

jane_acme: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
